description: Run an SFDR Principal Adverse Impact pre-screening on a counterparty wallet before settlement or investment. Combines ESG scoring and AML/sanctions screening into a single structured result formatted for SFDR compliance workflows. Returns a unique screeningId for regulatory documentation and audit trail — replaces 20–40 minutes of manual analyst work per counterparty. Required for EU SFDR PAI reporting and CSRD financed emissions disclosure. Returns PASS, REVIEW, or FAIL with full PAI indicator mapping. Cost: $10 USDC per screening via x402.

amount.description: Transaction amount in USD — used for AML risk calibration

entityName.description: Entity name for the audit record

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (20-character LEI) — alternative to wallet address

name: compliance.sfdr_screen
